classification.summary: The share-buy entry point (selector 0xe9ccf3a3) sent AVAX back to the caller before finalising share accounting, letting the attacker re-enter the weight-setting function (selector 0x5632b2e4) mid-call so that a single share could then be sold via sellShares() for ~266,000 AVAX.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
